turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm a student and I've got about thirty quid a week for food. Help.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's doable with a plan. Build meals around cheap bases like rice, pasta, oats, lentils and eggs.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's fine. A big pot of chilli or a lentil curry takes one pan and gives you four or five meals.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Four meals of the same thing though.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Change the toppings. Have it with rice one night, in a wrap the next, on a baked potato after that.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Huh. Okay, where should I shop?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The discount supermarkets, and go near closing time for the yellow sticker reductions on bread and meat.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And frozen veg, is that sad?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not at all, it's frozen right after picking, so it's often just as good. It also never goes off in your fridge.
